English: Warrior Gathering Ring
A crude ring of stones and firepits where warriors assemble for basic mustering, stories, and vows before raiding expeditions.
Practice Circle
A rough patch of trampled earth where youth and warriors spar, practice with wooden weapons, and settle disputes.
Mounted Drill Yard
A makeshift paddock for training horses and riders for hit-and-run raids and fast formations.
Weapons Rack Camp
A cluster of weapon racks, lean-tos, and guarded tents where arms are stored and maintained, ready for sudden assembly.
Raiders Pavilion
A large, ornate tent reserved for the chieftains to plan raids, store spoils, and rally the bravest warriors before battle.
Trained Riders' Field
A wide, well-trodden tract for maneuver exercises, with instructors drilling select riders in advanced tactics and formation riding.
Battle-Ready Arena
A fortified arena of wooden palisades and stands, where warriors compete in mock battles, contests of skill, and horde-wide assemblies.
Commanders Stand
A tall wooden tower and command dais, allowing leaders to oversee musters, issue orders, and inspire the horde.
Elite Muster Ground
A vast, well-tended field and encampment for the hordes finest, with permanent lodges, storehouses, and armories for rapid assembly.
Khans Rally Square
A grand, paved assembly ground with banners, shrines, and a permanent stage for the Khan to address and unite the entire horde before campaigns of legend.
